title: orthocarpus faucibarbatus var. albidus
intro: Orthocarpus faucibarbatus var. albidus, commonly known as White Plume Cudweed, is a variety of the Orthocarpus genus, a type of flowering plant. White Plume Cudweed is said to have several health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and act as an anti-oxidant, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as soothing skin irritations and calming the digestive system. The bioactive constituents of White Plume Cudweed include flavonoids and triterpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic actions and health benefits of White Plume Cudweed.
